summary: Reviewed 15 selected items for cycle 1. All are substantive, well-sourced AI/ML posts with clear provenance and no special-account replies requiring context verification. The Qwen 3.8 27B local-inference story appears via the official Alibaba_Qwen announcement and AlexFinn's independent RTX 5090 benchmark; these are the same topic from distinct angles (official confirmation vs. practitioner benchmark) and both add value, so both are kept and flagged rather than deduped. No redundant stories, fingerprint collisions, or coverage gaps warranting replacement. All reserve-pool items carry pool_role='reserve' and are therefore ineligible as replacement candidates, but no replacements are needed.
